section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
excerpt: In short, an ASL-4 system is more capable than the best humans in some key areas of concern, while still not being so across the board, and lacking some features needed to survive in the world in the long-term in the face of concerted human resistance.
paraphrase: An ASL-4 system exceeds the best humans in some key concern areas but not universally, and lacks some capabilities needed to survive long-term against concerted human resistance.

section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
excerpt: We do not yet know the right containment or deployment measures for ASL-4 systems, but it is useful to make a guess so that we can begin preparations as early as possible. A possible sketch includes:
paraphrase: Anthropic doesn't yet know the right ASL-4 containment/deployment measures but offers an early sketch to begin preparation.

section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
excerpt: Security: Security of the systems containing ASL-4 models that exceeds that of the strongest current technology companies. Model theft should be prohibitively costly for state-level actors, even with the help of a significant number of employees and the model itself.
paraphrase: ASL-4 security should exceed the strongest current tech companies, making model theft prohibitively costly for state actors even with insider help.

section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
context_stem: Security: Security of the systems containing ASL-4 models that exceeds that of the strongest current technology companies...
excerpt: For example, this may include attainment of intelligence community physical security standards like SCIFs, and software protection akin to that appropriate for Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) or higher, top-tier pentesting including access to privileged internal accounts, confidential computing, model-augmented security, automated detection, and strong internal controls.
paraphrase: Examples include SCIF-level physical security, TS/SCI-equivalent software protection, top-tier pentesting with privileged access, confidential computing, model-augmented security, automated detection, and strong internal controls.

section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
context_stem: Security: Security of the systems containing ASL-4 models that exceeds that of the strongest current technology companies...
excerpt: Sufficient measures will likely require novel security research and techniques, and multiple years of advance planning.
paraphrase: Adequate ASL-4 security will likely require novel research and years of advance planning.

section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
excerpt: Safety research: Sufficient progress on the science of interpretability, alignment training, and model evaluations to make an "affirmative case" that our models will not autonomously attempt to strategically undermine our safety measures or cause large-scale catastrophe.
paraphrase: ASL-4 requires enough progress in interpretability, alignment, and evaluations to make an affirmative case models won't strategically undermine safety measures or cause catastrophe.

section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
excerpt: Evaluations: Measuring the true capabilities of ASL-4 models may be extremely challenging, since it is difficult to predict what many cooperating AIs with significant resources will be capable of.
paraphrase: Measuring true ASL-4 capabilities may be very challenging given difficulty predicting cooperating AIs with significant resources.

section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
context_stem: Evaluations: Measuring the true capabilities of ASL-4 models may be extremely challenging...
excerpt: Evaluations of such models should also consider whether the model is capable of systematically undermining the evaluation itself, if it had reason to do so.
paraphrase: Evaluations should also assess whether the model could systematically undermine the evaluation itself if motivated to.

section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
excerpt: Automated harm detection: All use (internal and external) is subject to automated detection for attempts to cause harm, exfiltrate weights, or make changes to training runs.
paraphrase: All internal and external use is subject to automated detection of attempts to cause harm, exfiltrate weights, or alter training runs.

section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
context_stem: Automated harm detection: All use (internal and external) is subject to automated detection...
excerpt: Alarms should trigger a shutdown procedure, and red-teaming should confirm that models can't cause harm quickly enough to evade detection.
paraphrase: Alarms should trigger shutdown, and red-teaming should confirm models cannot cause harm quickly enough to evade detection.

section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
excerpt: External verification: Due to the large potential negative externalities of operating an ASL-4 lab, verifiability of the above measures should be supported by external audits.
paraphrase: Given large potential negative externalities of ASL-4 labs, the above measures should be verifiable via external audits.

section_heading: Early Thoughts on ASL-4 and Higher
excerpt: Unlike with the BSL system, there are likely to be levels beyond ASL-4. We make no attempt to define them yet, except to note that systems that could survive in the long-term against concerted human resistance, or entirely automate scientific research, might be classed above ASL-4.
paraphrase: Unlike the BSL system, levels beyond ASL-4 likely exist and are not yet defined, though systems surviving long-term against human resistance or fully automating scientific research might be classified above ASL-4.

excerpt: For autonomous capabilities, our ASL-3 warning sign evaluations will be designed with the advice of ARC Evals to test whether the model can perform tasks that are simpler precursors to full autonomous replication in the real world.
paraphrase: ASL-3 autonomous capability warning-sign evaluations are designed with ARC Evals to test simpler precursor tasks to full autonomous replication.

excerpt: The purpose of these evaluations is to quantify the risk that a model is capable of accumulating resources (e.g. through fraud), navigating computer systems, devising and executing coherent strategies, and surviving in the real world while avoiding being shut down.
paraphrase: These evaluations aim to quantify risk of resource accumulation, computer navigation, coherent strategy execution, and shutdown avoidance capabilities.
